text:
samir: Hey finance crew — quick approval request. Sparrow Labs (startup) is asking for a pilot pricing concession for a 90-day dedicated pilot. They want a 40% off first-month usage credit + net30 invoicing for pilot billing. their estimated first-month usage ~1.2M tokens. They'd sign a short SOW and commit to a sales/technical pilot. Can we approve a one-time pilot credit or do we want to issue a capped credit memo instead?

jess: +1 to supporting pilots but 40% feels high. What's the ARR motion if this converts? any channel/partner involved?

samir: Sales says potential ARR 200k ARR if converted within 12 months. Partner channel not involved. Reasoning: they're evaluating Dedicated for production and cite latency/cost concerns.

maria: Do we have their billing entity + PO? We need invoicing details for net30 and to confirm tax jurisdiction. Also, is this handled as a discount (rate change) or credit memo applied after billing?

logan: Financially, we prefer a credit memo for traceability. Suggest: 30% one-time credit capped at $7,500 for month 1, then standard list. If they actually exceed, we can revisit. Also need a cap per token or total dollar cap.

elaine: Legal needs the SOW and whatever custom terms (billing deferral). If there's any change to payment terms (net30 vs our default net15), flag to legal and contracts. No approval until SOW uploaded.

billing-bot: Billing run summary for Sparrow Labs: next invoice cycle 2026-08-01, current unpaid balance $0, projected pilot invoice $11,200 (at list).

samir: TL;DR proposal from finance-svcs: issue a one-time credit memo equal to 30% of month-1 charges, capped at $7,500, require signed SOW and MSA, net30 on pilot invoices, and a 30-day review checkpoint with CS/sales. If they want >30% we escalate to CFO.

jess: Sounds reasonable. Sales accepts cap and checkpoint. Jess approves contingent on SOW and signed MSA.

logan: Approving as finance manager for discounts up to 30% with the caps above. I'll draft the credit memo template and set the GL code to PilotCredits-2026.

elaine: Legal ok to proceed subject to SOW/standard MSA. I'll add a clause requiring pilot data deletion after 6 months if they don't convert.

mark: Mark (CFO) here — I approve this exception (30% capped $7,500) for Sparrow Labs pilot. Any increase beyond this must be routed to me. Please record the approval in Deal Desk and attach SOW.

samir: Great — I'll ask sales to upload SOW and confirm PO. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jess: will do, pinging @samir when doc is in GH.

samir: (closing) Recorded approval in Deal Desk: exception_granted:30pct_cap_7500. Moving to ops to generate credit memo once SOW attached.
